title: Rating Rule — Vehicle-Amendment Standing Surcharge from Billing History (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Rule

A vehicle amendment on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate carries a vehicle-amendment standing surcharge that follows the named insured's Cardinal Billing Account ledger within the past 12 months:

- a returned payment together with a notice of cancellation carries 5.00;
- a returned payment with no notice of cancellation carries 2.50;
- no returned payment carries none.

**Window.** A 12-month window covers the ledger entries whose posting date is less than 12 whole months before today, whole months being counted from the posting date to today.

## Truth table

| Returned payment on the ledger, past 12 months | Notice of cancellation on the ledger, past 12 months | Standing surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 5.00 |
| Yes | No | 2.50 |
| No | Yes | None |
| No | No | None |

## Hypothetical illustrations (today 15 November 2026)

- Returned payment posted 2 February 2026 and a notice of cancellation posted 20 February 2026: both within the window, 5.00.
- Returned payment posted 2 February 2026; the only notice of cancellation posted 10 November 2025 (12 whole months earlier): returned payment only within the window, 2.50.
- A notice of cancellation in July 2026 but no returned payment within the window: none.
